documents.title: Board Meeting Intimation for Board Meeting To Be Held On Tuesday, 27Th October, 2026
Board Meeting Outcome for Outcome Of The Board Meeting Held On 16Th October 2026
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Sky Gold & Diamonds Limited reported consolidated revenue of INR 2,013 crores for Q1 FY27, marking a 78% year-on-year growth. Management highlighted improvements in gross margins, a positive operating cash flow of approximately INR 30 crores, and the achievement of key strategic targets including the Advance Gold model share. The company maintains its long-term revenue roadmap of INR 8,100 crores for FY27 and INR 18,000 crores to INR 19,000 crores by FY30. Sky Gold and Diamonds Limited reported its Q1 FY27 financial results, achieving a revenue of ₹2,012.8 crore and a PAT of ₹104.9 crore. Management revised its FY27 revenue guidance upwards to approximately ₹8,100 crore with an EBITDA margin of 7.0-7.5%.

guidance.claim: The company remains on track to achieve its revenue aspiration of INR 8,100 crores by FY27 and INR 18,000 crores to INR 19,000 crores by FY30.
guidance.quote: We remain firmly on track to achieve our aspiration of INR8,100 crores by FY27 and INR18,000 crores to INR19,000 crores by FY30.

guidance.claim: The company expects FY27 revenue to be approximately ₹8,100 crore.
EBITDA margin for FY27 is expected in the range of 7.0% to 7.5%.
guidance.quote: EBITDA margin expected in the range of ~7.0-7.5%

guidance.claim: PAT margin for FY27 is guided at 4.5% to 4.75%.
By FY30, revenue is expected to be approximately ₹18,000 to ₹19,000 crore.
The management targets a sustainable revenue CAGR of 30% to 35%, projecting a PAT of INR 945 crores by 2030.
guidance.quote: Target growth metrics. We are targeting a sustainable revenue CAGR of 30% to 35%, projecting a PAT of INR945 crores by 2030.

guidance.claim: Management stated its goal of achieving sales of INR 18,000 crores to INR 19,000 crores with a nil net debt position by 2030.
guidance.quote: This strategic appointment reinforces our commitment to professionalizing management, enforcing strong governance and positioning the company for accelerated growth as we advance towards our FY30 target of achieving sales of INR18,000 crores to INR19,000 crores with a nil net debt position.

guidance.claim: Management decided to avoid volume guidance primarily due to volatility in gold prices.
guidance.quote: I want to make a small change to the guidance we have provided in the past. We would like to stick to our PAT guidance by FY30, but we would like to avoid volume guidance primarily because of the volatility in the gold price, which is beyond our control.

guidance.claim: Management guided for a conservative 5.25% PAT margin by FY2030.
guidance.quote: While these levers offer strong upside, we have guided for a conservative 5.25% PAT margin by FY2030, which represents an expansion of 75 basis points from current levels.

demand_outlook.claim: The company built a prospective export order pipeline of approximately INR 30 crores to INR 45 crores across the U.K. and European markets.
demand_outlook.quote: The response was highly encouraging, resulting in strong initial interest and helping us to build a prospective order pipeline of approximately INR30 crores to INR45 crores across the U.K. and European markets.

demand_outlook.claim: Lower karatage products like 18 KT, 14 KT, and 9 KT have been gaining market share due to appreciation in gold prices.
demand_outlook.quote: Lower KT products like 18 KT, 14 KT, 9 KT have been gaining market share due to appreciation in appreciation.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that B2B demand has remained stable without any softening so far following recent government measures.
demand_outlook.quote: And nowadays retailers have announced so many gold exchange schemes and with gold exchange, they will get more benefit in the making charges. Many schemes are rolled out. We have heard that at the retail level, the gold exchange has gone up from 20% to 40% above.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that retail gold exchange has increased from 20% to above 40%.
demand_outlook.quote: We have heard that at the retail level, the gold exchange has gone up from 20% to 40% above. The regular rate is 20% gold exchange business, it has gone to 40%.

capex_expansion.claim: Future capacity expansion is expected to be on a leased model requiring a capex of INR 80 crores to INR 100 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: It will be close to INR80 crores to INR100 crores, which will be just 20% to 25% of the PAT that we will generate at that point of time, since we have already built a world-class facility and we have already invested in the capacity and infrastructure.

capex_expansion.claim: The manufacturing footprint has expanded to 1,35,000 sq. ft.
capex_expansion.quote: Manufacturing footprint expanded to 1,35,000 sq. ft.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated that the company appointed agencies to monetize land, expecting to encash it by August or September end.
capex_expansion.quote: Yes, we have appointed 2 - 3 agencies also. We are expecting it by August end. I think August or September last, we will encash it. And so we have appointed 2 - 3 agencies for the same purpose also.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated gross margin increased to 9.3% in Q1 FY27 versus 9.1% in Q4 FY26.
margins_costs.quote: Our consolidated gross margin increased to 9.3% in Q1 FY27 versus 9.1% in Q4 FY26, an improvement of 27 basis points.

margins_costs.claim: Operating PAT for the quarter crossed the INR 100 crores mark for the first time.
margins_costs.quote: Operating PAT for the quarter crossed the INR100 crores mark for the first time.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA increased to INR 157 crores, representing 7.8% for the quarter.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA increased to INR157 crores, to 7.8% for the quarter.

margins_costs.claim: Value-added share of business has surged from under 10% in FY23 to approximately 50-55% in FY26.
margins_costs.quote: Value-Added share of business has surged from <10% in FY23 to ~50-55% in FY26, serving as the primary driver for gross margin expansion.

margins_costs.claim: Gold loss was reduced from 1.5% to a lean 0.5% through the implementation of an ERP.
margins_costs.quote: We have implemented an ERP to monitor operational KPI’s, this has led to reduction of gold loss from 1.5% to a lean 0.5%.

margins_costs.claim: The consolidated gross margin stands at 8.45% year-to-date, up 245 basis points from 6% in FY24.
margins_costs.quote: From the current year-to-date, our consolidated gross margin stands at 8.45%, up 245 basis points from 6% in FY24.

margins_costs.claim: Management reported that interest expenses currently account for 1.25% of sales.
margins_costs.quote: Today, interest expenses account for 1.25% of sales, which is a significant drag.

margins_costs.claim: Management expects gross margin to expand by 60 to 90 basis points due to a better mix of advanced gold and studded jewellery.
margins_costs.quote: We expect our gross margin to expand by 60 to 90 basis points due to better mix of advanced gold and studded jewellery.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that the FY26 PAT margin stands at 4.5%.
margins_costs.quote: Our FY26 PAT margin stands at 4.5%.

orders_capacity.claim: Current capacity utilization is close to 55% to 57%, and management states they are good until 2028.
orders_capacity.quote: Currently, the capacity utilization is close to 55%- 57%. And looking at the current projection numbers, we are good till 2028.

orders_capacity.claim: Management stated that the company achieved a capacity utilization run rate of 650 kgs per month in Q4.
orders_capacity.quote: Siddharth Sipani: We would like to just inform that in the last Q4, we have done around 650 kgs per month, and that is in line with our guidance that we have provided.

capital_allocation.claim: During the quarter, the company generated approximately INR 30 crores of operating cash flow.
capital_allocation.quote: I am pleased to report that during quarter, the company has generated approximately INR30 crores of operating cash flow, marking an important milestone in our journey towards building a stronger and more self- sufficient business model.

capital_allocation.claim: Beginning FY27, the company will adopt a zero-salary promoter compensation model where remuneration will be linked entirely to dividends declared from operating cash flow.
capital_allocation.quote: Beginning FY27, we will adopt a zero-salary promoter compensation model. Going forward, promoter remuneration will be linked entirely to dividends, and dividends will be declared only from operating cash flow generated by the business.

capital_allocation.claim: Management noted that net working capital days dropped from 71 days for the quarter ended March 2025 to 59 days for the quarter ended March 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: And our net working capital days have successfully dropped from 71 days for quarter ended March '25 to 59 days for this quarter ended March 26.

capital_allocation.claim: Management stated that cash from operations improved from negative INR 272 crores to near neutral operating cash flows of INR 45 crores negative.
capital_allocation.quote: Our cash from operations improved from negative INR272 crores to near neutral operating cash flows of INR45 crores negative, which is in line with our guidance.

risks_headwinds.claim: Heightened volatility in gold prices has created margin pressures across various retailers and manufacturers within the jewelry industry.
risks_headwinds.quote: In recent quarters, heightened volatility in gold prices has created margin pressures across various retailers and manufacturers within the jewelry industry.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that gold metal loans are currently costlier in terms of interest rates and market cost, resulting in zero gold metal loan exposure.
risks_headwinds.quote: So we go as per the whatever is PAT accretive. Right now, gold metal loan is very much costlier as per the cost, not, as per the interest rate. So, we are at zero gold metal loan right now.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated they will analyze one more quarter and revise their revenue target after Diwali.
management_commitments.quote: So, we will revise our target after Diwali. We'll analyze one more quarter, and we will give our new guidance post Diwali. That's our plan.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to increase the natural diamond contribution over the coming years.
management_commitments.quote: The company aims to increase this contribution over the coming years while simultaneously expanding its presence in the rapidly growing lab-grown diamond segment, backed by strong long-term demand trends and continued focus on both natural and lab-grown diamond is expected to strengthen the company's position in the diamond jewelry market and drive sustainable revenue growth and margins.

management_commitments.claim: Promoters will not draw salaries from FY27, with all promoter payouts solely through dividends.
management_commitments.quote: promoters will not draw salaries from FY27, all promoter payouts will be solely through dividends generated from operating cash flows.

management_commitments.claim: Management commits to reducing net debt by over 50% during FY27 through land sale and operational improvements.
management_commitments.quote: By aggressively executing our deleveraging strategy with targets of 50% + debt reduction during FY27, Sky Gold will drastically reduce its credit reliance.

management_commitments.claim: Management aims to achieve a sustainable revenue CAGR of 30% to 35% and a PAT of INR 945 crores by 2030.
management_commitments.quote: Target growth metrics. We are targeting a sustainable revenue CAGR of 30% to 35%, projecting a PAT of INR945 crores by 2030.

management_commitments.claim: Management aims to reach sales of INR 18,000 crores to INR 19,000 crores with a nil net debt position by FY30.
management_commitments.quote: This strategic appointment reinforces our commitment to professionalizing management, enforcing strong governance and positioning the company for accelerated growth as we advance towards our FY30 target of achieving sales of INR18,000 crores to INR19,000 crores with a nil net debt position.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
